summary: This proposed standard specifies the algorithms, parameters, key formats, key sizes and signature formats for subscribers of the Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) who sign certificates, certificate revocation lists and other signed objects. Setting one profile helps everyone interoperate. It builds on the broader RPKI specifications.

eli5.summary: A stamp used to prove who made something must follow set rules so everyone can check it. This sets the rules for the stamps used in the system that proves who owns internet address blocks.
